documents.title: TRANSCRIPT OF ANALYST/ INVESTOR EARNINGS CALL HELD ON 02.11.2026
UN-AUDITED FINANCIAL RESULTS FOR THE QUARTER AND HALF YEAR ENDED 30.09.2026
Board Meeting Outcome for UN-AUDITED FINANCIAL RESULTS FOR THE QUARTER AND HALF YEAR ENDED 30.09.2026

analysis.summary: Nitin Spinners reported its highest-ever quarterly revenue for the third consecutive quarter in Q2 FY27, driven by higher yarn realizations, stable demand, and increased sales volume in the fabric business. Management noted that partial trials have commenced for expansion projects, with commercial production across divisions expected by the end of December 2026. Renewable energy project investments are on schedule to become operational by December 2026, increasing renewable capacity to about 95 megawatts. The company remains focused on ramping up current expansions, maintaining margins within the 16% to 20% range, and balancing existing lines toward an aspirational top-line target in FY29. Nitin Spinners reported its Q2 FY27 performance, highlighting record quarterly revenue, exports, and fabric revenue alongside a sustained EBITDA margin of 17.8%.

guidance.claim: The company expects to reach a top line of INR4,800 crores to INR5,000 crores in FY29.
guidance.quote: So we are expecting that by going in FY29, we aspire that we should reach anywhere between INR4,800 crores to INR5,000 crores by -- with our existing assets and balancing some of them.

guidance.claim: The new capacity expansion is expected to add INR1,000 crores annually to the top line.
guidance.quote: So second, the total revenue out of this new project, which we are expecting is about INR1,000 crores. So we're expecting that we should be able to increase the revenues by another INR1,000 crores.

guidance.claim: The company expects to deliver profitable and sustainable growth in the upcoming year.
guidance.quote: With favourable trade policies, an expanding presence in value-added fabrics, a well-diversified export footprint and an increasing share of renewable energy in our energy mix, we are well positioned to sustain this momentum and deliver profitable and sustainable growth in the year ahead.

guidance.claim: Management targets fabric revenue to rise to approximately 30% of total revenue by FY28.
guidance.quote: • Fabric rises to ~30% of revenue by FY28

guidance.claim: Management states that the company's margins should remain in the 16% to 20% range.
guidance.quote: I guided or have informed that the kind of product mix which our company has, we should be in the range of 16% to 20%.

demand_outlook.claim: Yarn demand stayed healthy with steady buying from major importing countries and domestic players.
demand_outlook.quote: Yarn demand stayed healthy with steady buying from major importing countries as well as domestic players, amid stable tariff environment.

demand_outlook.claim: In the near term, inflationary conditions and liquidity strain in downstream channels are factors to be watched.
demand_outlook.quote: In the near term, the inflationary conditions across commodities and services and liquidity strain in the downstream channels are factors which are closely to be watched.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand-wise, business with Bangladesh is more or less stable.
demand_outlook.quote: Demand-wise, I think it is more or less stable with Bangladesh.

demand_outlook.claim: Exports were driven by better demand during the quarter.
demand_outlook.quote: Exports contributed 68% to the quarterly revenue, driven by better demand.

demand_outlook.claim: Management anticipates that the demand for fabric and yarn will continue to be better.
demand_outlook.quote: We anticipate that the demand for fabric and yarn will continue to be better, supported by demand coming from growth across the downstream sector and the consolidation of the spinning industry.

demand_outlook.claim: The recently implemented India-UK FTA is expected to support India's exports by opening up new opportunities.
demand_outlook.quote: The recently implemented India U.K. FTA is also expected to support India's exports by opening up new sourcing and export opportunities for the Indian textile sector.

capex_expansion.claim: Partial trials have commenced in all segments of the expansion projects.
capex_expansion.quote: Regarding capex, we are pleased to inform that partial trials have commenced in all the segments of the expansion projects.

capex_expansion.claim: Commercial production in all divisions is expected to commence by the end of December 2026.
capex_expansion.quote: Commercial production in all the divisions is expected to commence by the end of December '26 as planned.

capex_expansion.claim: Renewable project investments are progressing as per schedule and are expected to get operational by the end of December 2026.
capex_expansion.quote: On renewable project investments, are progressing per schedule and expected to get operational by end of December '26.

capex_expansion.claim: Renewable energy capacity will increase from 41 megawatts to about 95 megawatts post expansion.
capex_expansion.quote: This will take our renewable energy capacity from 41 megawatt to about 95 megawatt and meeting about 50% to 55% of power needs post expansion.

capex_expansion.claim: Trial production of griege woven fabric has commenced as part of the ongoing brownfield expansion.
capex_expansion.quote: On the capacity expansion front, we have commenced trial production of griege woven fabric.

capex_expansion.claim: Full commissioning of the expansion projects is expected by the end of December 2026.
capex_expansion.quote: The projects are in the advanced stage of commissioning, with partial trial production already commenced. Full commissioning is expected by the end of December 2026.

capex_expansion.claim: Fabric capacity is expanding by another 35 million meters and spinning capacity by an additional 74,000 spindles.
capex_expansion.quote: Going forward, our -- one of our future growth driver will be our capacity addition, which is going -- progressing as schedule with the expansion of our fabric capacity by another 35 million meters and spinning capacity by additional 74,000 spindles.

capex_expansion.claim: The renewable power expansion plan is expected to be operational by the end of Q3 '27.
capex_expansion.quote: The renewable power expansion plan is also going as per schedule and expected to be operational by the end of Q3 '27.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin for the quarter stood at 17.8% compared to 13.1% in Q2 FY26.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin stood at 17.8% as against 13.1% in Q2 FY26, that is an expansion of 471 basis points and was sustained at the Q1 FY27 level of 17.78%.

margins_costs.claim: Cost pressures are being observed on input items including dyes, chemicals, coal, packaging costs, and freight.
margins_costs.quote: We are seeing a lot of the input costs going up, including the dyes, chemicals, coal, packaging costs, the freights are increasing. Also, we are seeing the sea freight increase.

margins_costs.claim: Adjusted for trial production revenue and EBITDA loss, the quarter's EBITDA margin was 18.5%.
margins_costs.quote: So effectively, the EBITDA margin is 18.5%.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin was sustained at 17.8%, supported by higher yarn realizations, optimum capacity utilization, and ongoing cost saving measures.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin was sustained at 17.8%, supported by higher yarn realizations, optimum capacity utilization and ongoing cost saving measures.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin for Q1 FY27 stood at 17.78%, an increase of 376 bps on a year-on-year basis.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin for this quarter stood at 17.78% against Q1 FY26 margins of 14.02% is an increase of 376 bps on a year-on-year basis and 261 bps on quarter-on-quarter basis.

margins_costs.claim: Cotton prices increased during quarter 1 by about 8% to 10%.
margins_costs.quote: Cotton prices increased during quarter 1 by about 8% to 10%, primarily driven by overall lower global production, global supply chain and logistics challenges due to West Asia war.

orders_capacity.claim: In Q2 FY27, spinning capacity utilization was over 98% and woven fabric capacity utilization was about 90%.
orders_capacity.quote: In Q2 FY27, the spinning capacity utilization was over 98% and woven fabric capacity utilization was about 90%.

orders_capacity.claim: In FY27, spinning capacity operated at 98% utilization and woven fabric over 92% utilization.
orders_capacity.quote: In FY27, our spinning capacity was operating at 98% utilization and woven fabric over 92% utilization.

capital_allocation.claim: Total term debt is projected to peak in March at about INR1,440 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: First of all, the peak debt which we are going to have will be about our total term debt will peak in this March at about INR1,440 crores, I think.

capital_allocation.claim: Working capital is around INR400 crores and may reach about INR500 crores plus during the peak.
capital_allocation.quote: And working capital, which is at about INR400 crores at this point of time, can reach maybe about INR500 crores plus during that time.

capital_allocation.claim: Management states it would not be prudent to go for a buyback at this point in time as the company is in a growth phase.
capital_allocation.quote: I think at this point of time we are in a growth phase. We are deploying our capital for the growth purposes, internal accruals as well as we are also taking some loans as well. So it would not be some it would not be prudent for us to go for buyback at this point of time.

risks_headwinds.claim: Domestic cotton prices moved up due to lower arrivals and concerns that deficient rainfall may lower the 2026-2027 crop.
risks_headwinds.quote: Domestic prices moved up around INR67,000 to INR68,000 per candy, on lower arrivals and concerns, that deficient rainfall in some parts of India to lower the '26-'27 crop.

risks_headwinds.claim: The knit fabric business utilization is at 55% to 60% due to uncertainties prevailing in the US market.
risks_headwinds.quote: We have not yet reached that level due to the various uncertainties which is still prevailing in the US market.

management_commitments.claim: Commercial production in all divisions is expected to commence by the end of December 2026.
management_commitments.quote: Commercial production in all the divisions is expected to commence by the end of December '26 as planned.

management_commitments.claim: Renewable energy projects are expected to get operational by the end of December 2026.
management_commitments.quote: On renewable project investments, are progressing per schedule and expected to get operational by end of December '26.

management_commitments.claim: Spinning capacity utilization is expected to reach the normal 95% plus level by the end of March this year.
management_commitments.quote: However, the capacity utilization, we expect that spinning capacity, we should be able to reach the normal 95% level, 95% plus level by the end of March this year.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to reach INR4,800 crores to INR5,000 crores top-line in FY29.
management_commitments.quote: So we are expecting that by going in FY29, we aspire that we should reach anywhere between INR4,800 crores to INR5,000 crores by -- with our existing assets and balancing some of them.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to spend INR80 crores to INR100 crores for modernization and other things in the next financial year.
management_commitments.quote: Yes. In the next year, we are -- since we are planning to modernize and rebalance our capacities, we expect that we'll be spending in the range of about INR80 crores to INR100 crores for our modernization and other things.

management_commitments.claim: Full commissioning of the ongoing expansion projects is expected by the end of December 2026.
management_commitments.quote: Full commissioning is expected by the end of December 2026.

management_commitments.claim: Fabric is projected to rise to approximately 30% of total revenue by FY28.
management_commitments.quote: • Fabric rises to ~30% of revenue by FY28

management_commitments.claim: The renewable power expansion plan is expected to be operational by the end of Q3 '27.
management_commitments.quote: The renewable power expansion plan is also going as per schedule and expected to be operational by the end of Q3 '27.

management_commitments.claim: Spinning capacities are expected to be ramped up by 31st of March of this financial year.
management_commitments.quote: I think we would have ramped up all our capacities by 31st of March of this financial year.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
